No accounts. No cloud. Nobody watching you skip the same song at 3am.

The big streaming apps want your email, your phone number and every song you've ever played, so they can hand it back to you once a year as a slideshow. Some other clients ask you to sign in with Google inside an APK you downloaded off GitHub. Bold.

Minim went the other way. Google sign-in and Firebase are gone, there are no accounts, and Minim collects nothing. The old cloud copy of your library has been deleted.

Everything stays on your phone now, kept by Minim Fermata. It backs up to a folder you pick, and syncs your phones through that same folder. Its recommendations are here too, in the radio and Discover, worked out on your phone. Your taste isn't anyone's ad target.

Built-in Gemini left with Firebase, so add your own free Google AI Studio key under Gemini to keep lyrics, translation and chat working.
